Heron Arts on Instagram: "Heron Arts is proud to announce our next group exhibition “Lucid Plane” opening on Thursday, December 11, 6-9pm. This show will present the transcendental works of 12 artists curated by Dorka Keehn, @dorka1 & Tova Lobatz, @tovabatzz. 

Blurring the line between dream and vision, “Lucid Plane” highlights psychedelic aesthetics through radiant color palettes, dream-like compositions, visual representations of neuroplasticity, and augmented realities. Experience a contemporary perspective of psychedelia by way of painting, sculpture, new media and photography. 

Opening Reception: Thursday, December 11, 6-9pm; RSVP by clicking the link in our bio

Exhibition Dates: December 11, 2025 - January 22, 2026

Featuring:
Miguel Arzabe, @miguel.arzabe
Jay Blakesberg, @jayblak
